findingDetails.title: Visual-review vocabulary never reaches the frontend surface
findingDetails.claim: The documented visual-review phrases do not reach sk-code-frontend; replaying 'design review findings' and 'design review of this pricing page' resolves to sk-code-review alone.
evidenceRefs: command:compiled-route --hub sk-code --prompt 'design review of this pricing page'
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Tried the exact phrase in the frontend ROUTER, the shorter legacy alias, and a phrase that does bundle ('review this screen'); the bundle works only for the phrase that matches no review-class keyword.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The tie-break may intentionally prefer the code-review workflow and expect it to load frontend evidence itself; rejected because the packet contract bundles the surface beside review when the request needs visual review, and the sibling phrase does bundle it.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade to P2 if sk-code-review is shown to load web-visual-hierarchy.md for every UI review regardless of the hub route.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep hits the phrase in hub-router.json:90 and sk-code-frontend/ROUTER.md:48; the replay of 'review this screen' returns surfaceBundle [sk-code-review, sk-code-frontend].

findingDetails.title: Graph metadata still advertises the retired values vocabulary
findingDetails.claim: sk-design graph-metadata.json keeps ten retired fundamentals phrases in derived.intent_signals while the phase summary says they were removed and the top-level intent_signals carries none of them.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked every consumer path: the advisor joins top-level intent_signals and derived.trigger_phrases only, so no live route reads derived.intent_signals.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The field may be an authored summary rather than generated state; that still leaves it contradicting the phase summary and the top-level signal set.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None at P2; it becomes P1 only if a routing consumer starts reading derived.intent_signals.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep -n over the file finds the ten phrases only inside derived.intent_signals; top-level intent_signals and derived.trigger_phrases contain none of them.
